ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Shokkweave Economy
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Campaign law for the sole-source ruling in design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_webwork.md section 6 ban 4: hyperweave IS shokkweave, renamed, and the Webwork is the only way to obtain it. Built for SHOKKWEAVE_SOLE_SOURCE_1, build-order step 1 (see design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/kits/shokkweave_sole_source_spec.md):
- Renames Hyperweave (defName UNCHANGED, Core shortHash 26103) to "shokkweave" with new flavor text. 617 RecipeDefs and every savegame reference keep working because the defName never moves. - Strips trader stocking via tradeability All -> Sellable: colonists can still sell it, but no trader (SingleDef, Tag, or Category route) ever generates or stocks it. TraderCanSell() gates Verse.RimWorld.StockGeneratorUtility.TryMakeForStockSingle directly, so this closes the KotOR guy762 SingleDef traders (Czerka, HuttGalleon) without touching their XML. - Strips it from the standard quest-reward pool (thingSetMakerTags: RewardStandardCore). - Belt-and-braces: also removes the ExoticMisc trade tag it is reached through. - Halves its stuff-commonality (0.1 -> 0.05) so rare offworld shokkweave gear survives as flavor at half the vanilla roll rate. - Gives the donor Wyyyschokk (mlie.starwarsanimalcollection) a small butcher yield of shokkweave: the silk is in the spider, not its hide (race.leatherDef untouched).
Out of scope here (see the item and spec): live trader-generation proof (needs a quicktest map), and the web-cutting/nest-raid/border-creep-web harvest routes (block on unbuilt roster ThingDefs).
